title: Literal passwords nested inside YAML mappings
summary: A synthetic literal under password: one, two or three levels deep (database, auth, spec.auth), in block-style YAML.
rationale: Excluding structural keys must not cost recall. A literal is just as real three levels down, and depth is precisely where a line-local rule loses the key.

expectation.rationale: Flagged. The key holds a scalar literal regardless of indentation depth.
